label: D1 after an unrewarded visit to S1 (strongest after common a1->S1 omission)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2), almost always when the reward input is 0 (prev_reward==0 has 89% recall and 99.7% of the activation mass; the leftover ~11% of active steps are tiny activations after rewarded trials). It NEVER fires after an unrewarded visit to S2: every active step with prev_reward==0 has prev_state 1 or unknown (window-first trial). In magnitude it is asymmetric. After a common a1->S1 trial that went unrewarded it is large (precision 0.88, 76% of mass), with the biggest activations (~1.0 of max) on the first omission after a run of rewarded a1->S1 trials while S1 is good. After a rare a2->S1 omission it is weak and unreliable (precision 0.42, 7% of mass). Unrewarded window-first trials (rel -3, previous state outside the window) make up most of the remaining misses. Activity drops later in the episode (ep_trial > 60). The predicate uses only observed variables (the previous trial's state and reward). Dev F1 0.67. Adding prev_action==1 raises precision but cuts recall (F1 0.60).
